summary: 67-year-old Ophir resident Peter Harrelson caught and killed in an avalanche in Waterfall Creek south of Ophir; friends found him overdue Monday evening, followed his tracks but could not locate him; San Miguel County Sheriff's Office-led search with San Miguel County SAR, Helitrax and CAIC ran Monday night into Tuesday morning, with avalanche mitigation to reach the site; body recovered Tuesday morning with traumatic injuries; first Colorado avalanche fatality of the season.
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office / San Miguel County SAR
notes: Incident date from CAIC preliminary report, weekday-verified Monday. Surfaced via the Alpine-Archuleta thin-year news crawl (San Miguel County incident, inserted here per adjacent-county convention); flagged to the San Miguel County Sheriff news-alerts roster line. advnture.com retelling (opened run 456) adds: friend followed a fresh track up the locally-named "Banker" slope; Montrose Daily Press reported a 200-300 ft carry; Harrelson appears to have initially survived the slide before succumbing to traumatic injuries; San Miguel County Sheriff Bill Masters statement.
